lines: title:      "舞黒館 ― 毒物捜査",
title:      "Maicro House - Hunting the Poison",
endLabel:   "タイムリミットまで",
endLabel:   "Until the deadline",
exitLabel:  "捜査を終える",
exitLabel:  "End the investigation",
hint:       "部屋を選ぶと、その部屋の調査対象と話せる人がまとめて表示されます。",
hint:       "Choose a room to see everything you can search there and everyone you can speak to.",
title:"三人の共通点",
title:"What the three have in common",
text:"倒れた場所も行動も違う三人。まずは推測より先に、三人の身体に同じ痕跡が残っていないか確かめたい。",
text:"Three people, each found in a different place, each doing something different. Before guessing, check whether the same trace is left on all three bodies.",
question:"それぞれを同じ観点から調べれば、共通するものが見えてくるかもしれない。" },
question:"Examine each of them from the same angle, and something they share may come into view." },
title:"口にした場所へ戻る",
title:"Back to where it was drunk",
text:"倒れた場所と、毒を口にした場所は同じとは限らない。二人の間をつなぐ、洗われずに残った器がないだろうか。",
text:"Where someone collapsed is not necessarily where they swallowed the poison. Is there a vessel still unwashed that links the two of them?",
question:"調理に使ったものだけでなく、キッチンの流しに置かれたままのものも確かめてみよう。" },
question:"Check not only what was used for cooking, but whatever was left standing in the kitchen sink." },
title:"乾いた跡",
title:"A dried stain",
text:"液体が運ばれたなら、器だけでなく、途中でこぼれた場所にも痕跡が残る。昼の出来事を思い返したい。",
text:"If a liquid was carried, traces remain not only on the vessel but wherever it was spilled along the way. Think back over the afternoon.",
question:"一階で飲み物がこぼれた場所を、もう一度調べてみよう。" },
question:"Search again where a drink was spilled on the ground floor." },
title:"実験の続き",
title:"The experiment continues",
text:"毒の正体は確かめられたが、館に残った痕跡を見分ける知識がまだ足りない。実験は結果を聞いて終わりではない。",
text:"The poison has been identified, but you still lack the knowledge to recognize its traces around the house. An experiment does not end with hearing the result.",
question:"仮説を立てた人物へ結果を伝えれば、植物を調べる手がかりを借りられるかもしれない。" },
question:"Take the result back to the person who proposed the theory, and you may borrow the knowledge to examine the plant." },
title:"本と植物",
title:"The book and the plant",
text:"手元の本には、毒に使われた植物の性質が記されている。知識を得た今なら、以前は見分けられなかった痕跡に気づける。",
text:"The book in your hands describes the properties of the plant used for the poison. With that knowledge, you can now spot traces you could not before.",
question:"一階の、植物が置かれた明るい部屋へ戻り、鉢を詳しく調べてみよう。" },
question:"Go back to the bright room on the ground floor where the plant stands, and examine the pot closely." },
title:"遺体のそばに残ったもの",
title:"What was left beside the body",
text:"本人の身体だけでなく、身につけていたものにも毒が移っている可能性がある。小さな持ち物ほど見落としやすい。",
text:"Poison may have transferred not only to the body but to what the victim was carrying. The smaller the belonging, the easier it is to miss.",
question:"キッチンのご遺体を、所持品まで含めて確認してみよう。" },
question:"Examine the body in the kitchen, belongings and all." },
title:"拭き取られた作業場所",
title:"A workspace wiped clean",
text:"毒を用意したなら、液体を扱った場所に痕跡が残る。きれいすぎる場所も、何もないとは限らない。",
text:"Whoever prepared the poison left traces where the liquid was handled. A place that is too clean is not necessarily an empty one.",
question:"二階の個室で、天板だけ不自然に拭かれている机がないだろうか。" },
question:"In the private rooms upstairs, is there a desk whose top alone has been unnaturally wiped?" },
title:"机から持ち出されたもの",
title:"What was taken from the desk",
text:"拭かれた机で使われたものが、その後べつの場所へ運ばれた可能性がある。まず、その道具を特定したい。",
text:"Whatever was used at that wiped desk may have been carried somewhere else afterwards. First, identify the implement.",
question:"個室だけでなく、宿泊部屋の共用スペースに置き忘れられたものを確かめよう。" },
question:"Check not only the private rooms but whatever was left behind in the shared space of the guest quarters." },
title:"道具が触れた場所",
title:"Where the implement was used",
text:"拭かれた道具が見つかった。その道具が昼間に触れた場所なら、消し切れなかった毒が移っているかもしれない。",
text:"You have found the wiped implement. If it touched something during the day, poison that could not be wiped away may have transferred there.",
question:"二階の廊下で、昼にその道具を使って開けた仕掛けを調べてみよう。" },
question:"Examine the mechanism in the second-floor corridor that you opened with it during the day." },
title:"本に描かれた株",
title:"The plant drawn in the book",
text:"館内に残った毒の痕跡は集まった。次は、手元の本に描かれた植物が、この館のどこかにないか確かめたい。",
text:"You have gathered every trace of poison inside the house. Next, find out whether the plant drawn in the book grows somewhere on the grounds.",
question:"昼に歩いた庭へ戻り、ハーブが植えられていた一角を本の図と見比べてみよう。" },
question:"Go back to the garden you walked through during the day and compare the herb bed with the illustration." },
title:"採取した株を照合する",
title:"Matching the plant you took",
text:"庭の株を見つけただけでは、被害者から出た成分と同じものかは断定できない。比較するには鑑識の力が必要になる。",
text:"Finding the plant in the garden is not proof that it matches what came out of the victims. To compare them, you need forensics.",
question:"採取した株を、検査を手配できる人物へ見せてみよう。リビングにいる警察関係者なら頼めるはずだ。" },
question:"Show the plant you took to someone who can arrange a test. The police officer in the living room should be able to help." },
title:"毒が運ばれた跡",
title:"The path the poison took",
text:"毒の正体は見えてきた。次は、調合された場所から被害者のもとまで、何を介して運ばれたのかを考えたい。",
text:"The poison itself is coming into focus. Now think about what carried it from where it was mixed to the victims.",
question:"拭き取られた場所と、そこから持ち出されて別の場所でも使われた道具を、順番につないでみよう。" },
question:"Join up the place that was wiped clean and the implement taken from it and used elsewhere, in order." },
title:"倒れた場所と口にした場所",
title:"Where they fell, where they drank",
text:"三人が倒れた場所は一致しない。倒れた場所ではなく、それ以前に口にしたものへ視点を戻したい。",
text:"The three did not fall in the same place. Look past where they fell, back to what they drank before it.",
question:"お茶会で、誰の飲み物が誰へ渡ったのか。使われた器から確かめられないだろうか。" },
question:"At the tea party, whose drink went to whom? Perhaps the vessels can tell you." },
title:"仮説を確かめる",
title:"Testing the theory",
text:"セージに似た成分と、容器に残ったもの。この二つを組み合わせたとき何が起きるのか、まだ確かめていない。",
text:"Something like sage, and something left in a container. What happens when those two are combined has not yet been tested.",
question:"個人ではできない検査を、手配できる人物へ相談してみよう。" },
question:"Take a test you cannot run yourself to someone who can arrange it." },
title:"見つけた容器の意味",
title:"What the container means",
text:"不自然に洗われた容器が見つかった。中身が消えていても、残った反応から用途を考えられるかもしれない。",
text:"You have found a container washed unnaturally clean. Even with the contents gone, what remains may say what it was for.",
question:"セージの性質について仮説を話した人物に、この容器を見せてみよう。" },
question:"Show the container to the person who proposed the theory about sage." },
title:"混ぜたものがあるなら",
title:"If something was mixed in",
text:"何かを混ぜて性質を変えたのなら、調合や持ち運びに使ったものが残るはずだ。",
text:"If something was mixed in to change its properties, whatever was used to mix and carry it should still exist.",
question:"液体を入れられるもの、あるいは不自然に洗われているものが、誰かの荷物にないだろうか。" },
question:"Is there something that could hold a liquid, or something washed unnaturally clean, in anyone's luggage?" },
title:"無害なものが害を持つ条件",
title:"When the harmless turns harmful",
text:"普通のセージは無害。それでも三人から似た成分が出たなら、品種か、加えられた何かに違いがある。",
text:"Ordinary sage is harmless. If a similar compound came out of all three, then either the cultivar or something added to it is different.",
question:"植物や薬の性質に詳しい人物なら、この矛盾から仮説を立てられないだろうか。" },
question:"Someone who knows plants and drugs might build a theory out of that contradiction." },
title:"集めた情報をつなぐ",
title:"Tying the findings together",
text:"手がかりは単独では答えにならない。新しく聞けるようになった話と、まだ説明できていない痕跡を結び直そう。",
text:"No clue is an answer on its own. Tie the newly opened conversations to the traces you still cannot explain.",
question:"部屋カードの「新規会話」と、未確認の証拠品をもう一度見直してみよう。" }
question:"Look again at the “New talk” marks on the room cards, and at the evidence you have not yet checked." }
